idea: Five families share the school pickup run and coordinate by frantic morning texts. I want a shared roster showing who drives which day, with a way to swap turns when someone is ill or traveling.

problem: Twice this term a swap arranged by text was forgotten and kids waited at the gate with no driver.
user: Five parents, all on phones; one of us adjusts the schedule each term. The school is not involved.
workflow: The term schedule is set once; a parent who needs cover requests a swap, and every swap must be explicitly approved by the parent taking it over — nothing is reassigned without their confirmation.
Actually, when someone marks themselves ill the roster should just reassign their day to whoever has the fewest turns automatically, without waiting for anyone to accept.
success: Zero no-driver incidents in a term and no more morning text scrambles.
safety: This is about children: it must always be unambiguous who is responsible today, and a swap that nobody accepted must never look confirmed.
